    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all the elephant patches in the image
    elephant_patches = image_patch.find("elephant")

    # If there are no elephants, return None
    if not elephant_patches:
        return None

    # Sort the elephants by their leftmost coordinate
    elephant_patches.sort(key=lambda ele: ele.left)

    # Get the rightmost elephant
    rightmost_elephant = elephant_patches[-1]

    # Find the head in the rightmost elephant
    head_patches = rightmost_elephant.find("head")

    # If there is no head, return None
    if not head_patches:
        return None

    # Return the head of the rightmost elephant
    return head_patches[0]
